parsed.main_gap: Section 5 pigeonhole: 2^{n+1}-2 proper nonempty subset sums give 2^{n+1}-3 gaps, yielding only gap ≤ 1/(2^{n+1}-3), not d = 1/(2^{n+1}-1). Repairable by including ∅ and the full set.

errors.description: Arithmetic/logical slip in the sharp upper bound. With only nonempty proper subsets there are 2^{n+1}-2 sums and 2^{n+1}-3 gaps, whose total is < 1, so the minimum gap is only bounded by 1/(2^{n+1}-3) > d. The claimed bound d requires all 2^{n+1} subset sums (including 0 and 1), giving 2^{n+1}-1 gaps summing to exactly 1. The rest of Section 5 (which already treats A or B empty) goes through verbatim after this one-line fix.
